source: Keyframed pose bones, no drivers/constraints required for playback.

turn_policy.blend: Crossfade full-body turns for .12 sec. Keep gait phase across walk/run; use shortest-arc quaternion interpolation for facing. Do not reset end yaw to zero while visible. Use visual root delta OR actor yaw accumulation, not both.

locomotion.game_world_units_to_meters: Not defined by current 2D renderer; integration must choose scale.

attachment_notes: Weapons are skinned attachments. Thrown objects and fired arrows are spawned by the future runtime at events; the held mesh must be hidden/re-equipped by runtime. No damage/AI code included.
